landing.description: A Link Loom landing page (Astro, static) built from layers: the Mi Retail landing frame in English and Spanish, SEO and structured data, contact and legal pages, the image pipeline; the blog, full-text search and the development-only blog editor

brand.description: Changes the brand of a landing (colours, logo) and rebuilds the tokens, favicons and share images

page.description: Adds a page in both languages: its view with a hero and a closing call to action, its title for the breadcrumb, its copy and (optionally) its entry in the header menu or a footer column

section.description: Adds a section to a page from the standard kinds (hero, page-hero, logos, cards, split, faq, prose, final-cta, page-cta) with its copy in both languages

blog-post.description: Adds a blog post in English and Spanish, parallel by base_slug

copy.description: Adds or rewrites one text in both dictionaries (src/data/copy/en.ts and es.ts) under a dotted key
